assessment: At 20 Td, mean energy is now stationary and precise after the 8 microsecond burn. Drift remains statistically under-resolved. Its half-window direction reverses relative to the 3 microsecond run, so the retained evidence no longer supports a continuing monotonic drift transient; the remaining limitation is low signal-to-noise and long correlation time in the drift estimator.
next_gate: Use independent seeds and/or a longer measurement window at the already qualified burn horizon. Do not spend additional work extending burn-in unless energy stationarity regresses.
claim_boundary: The 20 Td mean energy is eligible for independent scoring, but 20 Td drift is not. The stationary 50 and 100 Td points remain eligible for future external comparison.
